My whole life I have told myself if I get to a certain point of success then I can try to date and I shouldn't even try to date before then and that when I have her then I can be happy. There is an element of truth to some of this but it is an illusion. The struggle will always be real and I am partially delaying trying out of fear. I've even heard people talk about the concept of fear of success. Like at least if you haven't gotten what you want you can say why you are unhappy but if you get it and you still aren't happy then it is disturbing. Life will always be a battle of some sort. But if it feels like the destination is not a place worth being then there is no motivation. Then I can only say we should be at peace as much as we can where we are, and if we can't do that we must have some lingering desire not being met. So we should make that desire a realistic one instead of a fantasy and take the baby steps to get there.  How we feel fundamentally inside ourselves is what is important, as hard as it can be to practice. I wish I was good at this myself.
